task_description:
This pipeline's task is GitHub issue #3364 — https://github.com/jwbron/egg/issues/3364. Fetch the live issue body (`gh issue view 3364`) before structural decisions. Worktree artifacts (drafts, agent outputs) that reference any other issue or pipeline are leftovers from previous runs — they are NOT your task.

# Slim the /sdlc skill to run + report + HITL — move monitoring/recovery into the orchestrator + overseer (issue #3364)

## Scope for this pipeline

Issue #3364 planned four independent PRs. **PR A already landed** (#3421: the consensus-timeout "Retry phase" decision now routes to the restart_phase path via `CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT_RETRY_OPTION` in `orchestrator/routes/decisions/_handlers.py`). This pipeline covers the **three remaining PRs: B, C, and D**. They are mutually independent; implement them as separate slices/units of work with separate risk profiles.

### PR B — Long-haul monitoring tooling (issue items 3 + 4)

- Add `--exclude-types` and `--quiet` flags to `skills/sdlc/bin/wait-status` (client-side JSON-line filtering; the file currently exposes only `--since` / `--inner-timeout` / `--max-iterations`). The launcher is pure stdlib and self-contained; keep it that way.
- Add a `slice.closed` event: new `EventType`, emitted at the slice scheduler's `record_complete` / `record_failure` sites, and added to the `/status/wait` allowlist (`_STATUS_WAIT_EVENT_TYPES`). Verified 2026-07-06: no slice event types exist anywhere in `orchestrator/` or `shared/` yet.
- Both changes are additive/low-risk; the skill consumes both.

### PR C — Supervision hardening (issue items 1 + 6)

All in `JobSupervisor` / `orchestrator/supervision_policy.py`:
- **Rate-limit ("quota" / cap-wall) classification distinct from `abnormal`**: `shared/egg_agent/auth_errors.py` deliberately excludes 429 / "rate limit" / "overloaded" from `EX_AUTH_FATAL` (#3373), so cap walls currently fall through to the `abnormal` path, hit the `agent-invocation-failure` streak (>=10), and halt in minutes because backoff caps at 30s in `supervision_policy.py`. Detect the all-producers failure-streak signature, classify as transient rate-limit.
- **Windowed paced retry**: retry across the rolling cap window (hours, not 30s), don't hammer, and preserve landed slices (a `restart_phase`-equivalent that does not discard completed slice work).
- **Deterministic-loop guard**: distinguish transient (paced retry) from deterministic failures — if a restart reproduces the identical failure at the same point, stop and escalate instead of looping.

### PR D — Slim the skill (issue item cleanup + items 2/7 backstops)

- Delete from `skills/sdlc/SKILL.md` (1600 lines as of 2026-07-06): the "Host detector migration (issue #1962)" section, the Overseer-Absent Fallback, and all five host-side detector blocks — Stall detection, Silent agent detection, NACK escalation, Long-Running Phase Detection, and the host-side detection trigger of Stuck Pipeline Rescue (roughly lines 553-793 plus the short-flow Stall detection block near line 1517). #1962 is closed; these are dead/duplicated logic.
- **Prerequisite (gate the deletion on this)**: coverage-map each deleted detector to an overseer detector that emits an `OVERSEER_ALERT` the skill already surfaces (`orchestrator/overseer/monitor/` — `_consensus_stall.py`, `_anomaly_checks.py`, `_escalation.py`), so nothing goes dark.
- Conclude the calibration window by **removing** `overseer_owns_host_detection` entirely (it still defaults to False in `orchestrator/models/_config.py` and is referenced in `orchestrator/routes/pipelines/_routes_status.py`), rather than flipping the default.
- Keep in the skill: argument parsing/seed, pre-refine triage, submit, the Monitor `wait-status` loop (render + cursor threading), HITL decision brokering (phase_gate / choice / feedback, two-wave surfacing, contract `cq-N` / `feedback-N`), surfacing `OVERSEER_ALERT`s to the user, the user-initiated Stuck Pipeline Rescue workflow (only its host-side detection trigger goes), and a short last-resort debugging section with thin backstop rules (never blind-action a destructive recommendation; `TaskStop` before Monitor re-arm).

## Out of scope

- Item 8 (durable context-measurement surface) — deferred to #3249.
- The 13 visibility-gap items from the issue comments (per-role commits_ahead surface, consensus-window countdown, alert feed, etc.) — those are follow-up orchestrator surfaces tracked in the issue comments and sibling issues (#3369, #3499, #3508, #3509), not this pipeline.

## Sequencing note

B, C, D are independent, but D's detector deletion must be gated on the coverage-map confirming overseer parity (the overseer detection loop in `orchestrator/overseer/monitor/` genuinely exists and #3341/#3343 landed the liveness-before-destructive gating).

## Additional Context

Code-verified state as of 2026-07-06 (this machine, main @ ca193b85b):
- `_handle_retry_phase`-equivalent exists (PR A landed, #3421) — do not redo it.
- `skills/sdlc/bin/wait-status`: no filtering flags yet.
- No `slice.closed` / slice EventType anywhere.
- `shared/egg_agent/auth_errors.py` lines 24-28 and 45-46: throttling signatures intentionally absent from fatal patterns; the transient path is what needs the new classification.
- `overseer_owns_host_detection` lives in `orchestrator/models/_config.py` and `orchestrator/routes/pipelines/_routes_status.py`.
- `skills/sdlc/SKILL.md` is exactly 1600 lines with all five detector blocks still present.

decisions.question: PR C — when a rate-limit / subscription cap-wall persists, how should the windowed paced-retry bound itself? A weekly/subscription cap can stay shut for hours-to-days; "retry across the rolling window, don't hammer" sets the pacing but not the ceiling, and the ceiling is directly operator-visible (an unattended pipeline could sit paused a long time).

options.label: Retry until the cap lifts with NO wall-clock ceiling — parse the reset time from the error to pace when present, else bounded backoff. Cap walls (incl. multi-day weekly caps) self-heal with no operator action.
Paced-retry up to a max wall-clock ceiling (e.g. a few hours), then escalate to HITL / halt so an unattended pipeline cannot silently sit for days.
Retry until the cap lifts (no hard ceiling) BUT emit an OVERSEER_ALERT once the wait crosses a threshold, so an attended operator is informed while auto-recovery continues.
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.resolution: Retry until the cap lifts (no hard ceiling) BUT emit an OVERSEER_ALERT once the wait crosses a threshold, so an attended operator is informed while auto-recovery continues.

decisions.resolution:
Resolved Questions:

**PR C — when a rate-limit / subscription cap-wall persists, how should the windowed paced-retry bound itself?**
Answer: Retry until the cap lifts (no hard ceiling) BUT emit an OVERSEER_ALERT once the wait crosses a threshold, so an attended operator is informed while auto-recovery continues. (Resolved as cq-1 on the contract.)

decisions.question: PR C (slice-2) file-scope mismatch discovered during implement. AC-C1 requires the throttling signature to "classify as transient rate-limit, NOT abnormal, and NOT trip the fail-streak halt" (the per-key streak>=10 exhaustion). But the code only propagates a per-agent EXIT CODE to the orchestrator, never the agent's error TEXT: handle_agent_failure gets f"Container exited with code {N}" (_run_concurrent.py:737) and the exhaustion report's exit_detail is just "exit_code=N" (kubernetes_spawner/_models.py:102-131). The throttle wording (429/"rate limit"/"overloaded") the plan/architect assumed is "observable at the streak site" is NOT present there. The ONLY faithful mechanism is a distinct exit code, mirroring EX_AUTH_FATAL: auth_errors.py -> egg_agent/__main__.py:142 -> outcome_for (kubernetes_spawner) -> _observe_jobs (event_loop/_loop.py) -> record_fatal (event_loop/_supervisor.py). To satisfy AC-C1 ("does not trip the fail-streak halt"), the new transient class must be intercepted at the per-arm RECORDING layer, which now lives in event_loop/_supervisor.py (JobSupervisor moved there in the #3447 decomposition, AFTER the plan's "concurrent_executor.py (JobSupervisor integration)" anchor was written). PR C's contracted task files (orchestrator/supervision_policy.py, orchestrator/concurrent_executor.py, shared/egg_agent/auth_errors.py) do not include egg_agent/__main__.py, kubernetes_spawner/_models.py, event_loop/_loop.py, or event_loop/_supervisor.py. How should I proceed?

options.label: Expand PR C scope to the full EX_AUTH_FATAL-style mirror across the necessary files (add EX_RATE_LIMITED + is_transient_rate_limit_error to auth_errors.py; emit it in egg_agent/__main__.py; add a JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED outcome + outcome_for mapping in kubernetes_spawner/_models.py; a _observe_jobs branch in event_loop/_loop.py; a record_rate_limited paced/no-streak-halt path in event_loop/_supervisor.py; pacing+fingerprint constants in supervision_policy.py; and the windowed-retry/loop-guard/threshold-alert/landed-slice wiring in concurrent_executor.py). pr.title: Slim the /sdlc skill to run+report+HITL; harden supervision + long-haul monitoring (PRs B/C/D of #3364)
pr.description:
The three remaining, mutually-independent PRs of #3364 (PR A landed via
#3421 — not redone). Three independent slices, one PR each, disjoint file
sets so there is no integration collision:

- Slice 1 / PR B (additive, low risk): add client-side --exclude-types and
  --quiet filter flags to the pure-stdlib skills/sdlc/bin/wait-status, and
  add a new slice.closed EventType emitted at both SliceScheduler
  close sites (record_complete / record_failure) with an outcome field
  distinguishing success vs failure, allowlisted in _STATUS_WAIT_EVENT_TYPES
  so it reaches wait-status consumers.
- Slice 2 / PR C (behavioral, medium-high risk — highest here): a NEW
  transient rate-limit classification distinct from abnormal that keys off
  the all-producers agent-invocation-failure streak carrying the bare
  throttling wording auth_errors.py deliberately excludes from EX_AUTH_FATAL
  (429 / rate limit / overloaded); a windowed paced retry across the rolling
  cap window (hours, not the 30s cap) using a restart_phase-equivalent that
  preserves landed slices; and a deterministic-loop guard that escalates
  instead of looping when a restart reproduces the identical failure
  fingerprint at the same point. Per resolved cq-1: NO hard wall-clock
  ceiling, but an OVERSEER_ALERT fires once the cumulative wait crosses a
  threshold. EX_AUTH_FATAL (incl. matched weekly caps) and ordinary abnormal
  halts behave unchanged.
- Slice 3 / PR D (deletion, medium risk — GATED): task-3-1 coverage-maps
  each of the five host-detector blocks in SKILL.md to a concrete overseer
  emitter FIRST; any block with no confirmed emitter is raised as a HITL at
  point of discovery, not silently deleted. Only after the gate: delete the
  host-detector blocks + migration section + Overseer-Absent Fallback +
  Stuck-Rescue host trigger + short-flow Stall block (preserving the
  render-on-OVERSEER_ALERT AskUserQuestion flows and the user-initiated
  Rescue Steps 1-3), and remove overseer_owns_host_detection entirely.

Grounded live @ ca193b85b (2026-07-06). Critical grounded fact: there is NO
deterministic overseer emitter for agent-stall / agent-silent /
agent-nack-unresolved / phase-long-running — those ride the Haiku
classifier action:{action} path only — which is exactly why the PR-D
coverage-map is real verification work.
pr.test_plan:
Per slice; `make test` narrows to reachable suites, `make lint` green
throughout; run `make test-all` before phase exit.
- Slice 1 (PR B): wait-status --exclude-types drops a targeted event type
  and --quiet behaves per spec while default (non-filtered) output is
  unchanged (regression guard); a slice completion emits exactly one
  allowlisted slice.closed(success) and a slice failure emits exactly one
  allowlisted slice.closed(failure), each distinguishable by outcome.
- Slice 2 (PR C): throttling-streak classifies as transient rate-limit (NOT
  abnormal, does not trip the fail-streak halt); paced-retry pacing/window
  (reset-time-paced when present, else bounded backoff; threshold
  OVERSEER_ALERT fires per cq-1); landed slices preserved across a paced
  restart; loop-guard escalates on identical-fingerprint reproduction and
  continues when the restart advances state; regression: EX_AUTH_FATAL
  (incl. weekly cap) and ordinary abnormal halts fire unchanged.
- Slice 3 (PR D): grep-clean for overseer_owns_host_detection and
  run_migrated_detectors; orchestrator tests referencing the removed field
  updated/removed; SKILL.md still renders and the preserved Long-Running
  Implement Phase + Unresolved NACK AskUserQuestion flows remain
  structurally intact.
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: none. The three PRs are independent and may merge in any order
(B first is preferred for quick value). Post-merge: PR C changes live
supervision behavior — watch the first real cap-wall recovery to confirm the
threshold OVERSEER_ALERT fires and landed slices are preserved.
